data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate returns corresponding to the total returns of the securities as represented by the CRISIL Liquid Overnight Index before expenses, subject to tracking errors. The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
